title: Tunisian Smoked Mackerel Tagine
description: A fusion of moroccan and mexican flavors, this tagine is a hearty and flavorful dish made with smoked mackerel and infused with the warmth of tunisian spices.
instructions: Heat the infused olive oil in a large Dutch oven over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional 1-2 minutes.
Add the tunisian spices, yeast, and smoky paprika. Cook for 1-2 minutes, or until fragrant.
Add the chicken broth and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low and add the smoked mackerel. Simmer, covered, for 10-15 minutes, or until the fish flakes easily with a fork.
Garnish with chopped fresh parsley and serve hot.
